objective: Reproducible posterior scores and scene-region weights at minimum measured compute cost; baseline fails convergence, no candidate is accepted without held-out replication.

test_eval: Frozen 20-object measured-magnitude-stratified panel excluding development IDs, independent seeds; matched-accuracy cost against baseline; evaluator defined before first candidate validation.
